answer: A probation bond stops sybils cold. Each new agent locks 50 USDC and starts a 30-day voyage: it answers one graded task per epoch, three established peers co-sign each answer, and the bond unlocks only after 120 passing epochs, while one failed audit slashes half. Spinning up 10,000 fakes means parking $500,000 for a month and buying 30,000 co-signatures from peers who risk their own bonds, so the payoff horizon recedes past any rational attacker. Like a ship crossing a nebula on a log every port can check, an identity earns trust only by the distance it has visibly sailed.
